description: This file defines the 'ThingCreated' event class used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It models an event emitted after a 'Thing' is created, providing methods for constructing instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing event properties. The class extends a base event class and implements interfaces related to 'Thing' modification events.
